A [[Human/Legends|Human]], '''Odin Nesloor''' lost his family when their [[Starship/Legends|ship]] disappeared into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] sometime before the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. Nesloor went to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in search of his family and worked as a [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] at the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Mos Espa Grand Arena]] shortly before the start of the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|Podrace]] in 32 BBY.

==Biography==
Odin Nesloor was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lost his family when their [[Starship/Legends|ship]] vanished into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]<ref name="Card" /> sometime prior to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], which occurred after Nesloor's family disappeared, to 32 BBY.</ref> He combed [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] looking for them, and his best lead took him to the<ref name="Card" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Card" /> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] 32 BBY,<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> he was in the [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] at Tatooine's [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Mos Espa Grand Arena]] working as a [[Podracing/Legends|Podrace]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] just prior to the start of the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] race.<ref name="TPM" />

==Personality and traits==
Odin Nesloor had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and fair skin. As a typical Human, Nesloor was not capable of [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] the extremely fast Podracers. However, he still worked as a Podrace mechanic. He was part of a group of expert mechanics who were largely unsung geniuses and who built some of the best [[Engine/Legends|engines]] for Podracers. On at least one occasion, Nesloor wore a green [[Jumpsuit/Legends|jumpsuit]], black coveralls, and [[Welding goggles/Legends|welding goggles]].<ref name="EpisodeIVD">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:DarkHellionSwoopGangMember.jpg|thumb|left|75px|Miniature Odin Nesloor look-alike]]
Odin Nesloor first appeared in the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM" /> He was later included as a card in the ''[[Coruscant Limited]]'' expansion set for the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="Card" /> He was mentioned and pictured in the 1999 reference book [[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary|''Star Wars: Episode I The Visual Dictionary'']]<ref name="EpisodeIVD" /> and the subsequent [[2006]] omnibus ''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''.<ref name="CVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> [[Bounty Hunters (Star Wars Miniatures)|''Star Wars Miniatures: Bounty Hunters'']] contains a miniature figure of a [[Dark Star Hellions/Legends|Dark Hellion]] [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] member who has a strong resemblance to Odin Nesloor.<ref name="Miniatures">{{SWMiniCite|set=Bounty Hunters|pack=Dark Hellion Swoop Gang Member}}</ref>
